clusters.description: Cluster configurations, keyed by the name given to `gcloud kubeconfig`

Secret.description: Secret addresses a single field of a 1Password item, in the same terms as an `op://` reference: `op://<vault>/<item>/<field>`, resolved against Account.

account.description:
Account is the 1Password account the vault belongs to, as a sign-in
address or account UUID.

vault.description: Vault is the name or UUID of the vault holding the item.

item.description: Item is the name or UUID of the item within the vault.

field.description: Field is the name of the field to read from the item, e.g. `password`.

path.description: Directory for browser profile dirs (e.g. .posh/browser); created on startup

command.description: Browser binary path; defaults to Chrome on macOS, google-chrome on Linux

profiles.description: Named environments, each with an optional proxy and default URL

app.description: App indicates whether the application mode is enabled for the profile.

url.description: Default URL to open when no URL argument is given

type.description: Access mode passed to `cloudflared access`, e.g. tcp or ssh

hostname.description: Hostname of the Cloudflare Access target to tunnel to

port.description: Local port the tunnel listens on, bound to 127.0.0.1

path.description: Path used as HOME for every cloudflared call, keeping its credentials per project

access.description: Access configurations, keyed by the name given to `access connect`

sources.description:
SourcesMap maps a source name to a golang-migrate source URL, e.g.
`file://migrations`. The names are the values the `source` argument accepts.

databases.description:
DatabasesMap maps a database name to a golang-migrate database URL, e.g.
`pgx5://user:password@localhost:5432/db?sslmode=disable`. The names are the
values the `database` argument accepts. A value may contain 1Password
secret references, which are resolved at execution time.
